versions.name: Current
versions.description: The sprite the game uses now, with its walk and attacks.

versions.name: Thornwarden
versions.description: A deep green hood shading the brow and cheek, a short mantle, leather armour and a bow held at rest. Standing proposal, both directions; no walk or attack animation.

versions.name: Greenhood
versions.description: The classic hooded ranger, done right: a bright pointed hood whose lit rim frames a clear face, a dark braid, a dagged capelet and red-fletched arrows over the shoulder. Replaces the cap-like hood, hidden face and claw-like arrows with one clean silhouette and a bow held at the grip.

versions.name: Copper Tail
versions.description: Hood down: a copper ponytail tied in green falls down her back like the knight's plume, over a leaf-cut capelet, leather and dark green leggings. Warm and cool blocks alternate as on the knight, so she reads at a glance instead of as a muddy brown figure.

versions.name: Mossmantle
versions.description: A deep olive hood lined in crimson frames her face, with a gold clasp, a long mossy cloak thrown back and a crimson grip on the bow. Fixes Thornwarden's hidden face and loose cape: the red lining is the one focal accent, and the cloak hangs from the hood as one shape.

versions.name: Silverleaf
versions.description: An elven huntress: silver hair, a long pointed ear, a teal leaf mantle and a pale birch bow whose moonstone glows at night. A cool, light silhouette that stands out on the dark forest floor, unlike the brown and olive rangers before her.

versions.name: Current
versions.description: The sprite the game uses now, with its walk and attacks.

versions.name: Ember Archmage
versions.description: A tapered wizard hat with a forward-bent tip and a narrower brim, a stern face and shorter beard, steel shoulders, blue and antique-gold robes, a planted staff and a flame in the free hand. Standing proposal, both directions; no walk or attack animation.

versions.name: Grand Archmage
versions.description: The classic Eldrin rebuilt: brim, band and cone all centred on the skull, the brim dipping over the brow onto white hair and throwing a shadow on stern V-brows, a long beard hanging from the chin, an ember orb in a gold cup and a white-hot fireball in his raised hand.

versions.name: Battlemage
versions.description: A grizzled war-wizard: a battered leather hat worn low, its brim centred and its tip folded forward, a crimson coat with a baldric, a steel pauldron and bracer, a fireball held forward on an open palm and an iron-crowned staff planted behind, in a wide stride like the knight's.

versions.name: Ember Prodigy
versions.description: A young fire sorcerer: a straight plum hat with a gold flame emblem, seated on swept-back red hair that fills the back of the brim, stern brows in its shadow, a fitted coat with gold lapels, a fireball raised high and a gold-ring ember staff.

versions.name: Ashen Pyromancer
versions.description: A mysterious ash-grey pyromancer: a wide slouched hat, centred on the head, throws the face into shadow so only two ember eyes show above a red scarf; he cups a flame before his chest, carries a caged-lantern staff, and his hem smoulders.

versions.name: Current
versions.description: The sprite the game uses now, with its walk and attacks.

versions.name: Grave Regent
versions.description: A fitted ash-violet hood, bone pauldrons over a split crimson robe, a green-eyed skull and a forward-leaning skull staff. Standing proposal, both directions; no walk or attack animation.

versions.name: Ossuary King
versions.description: An exposed crowned skull, broad spiked bone pauldrons, a dark ribbed cuirass, ash-green robes and a hooked soul staff. An alternative to the hooded Grave Regent. Standing proposal, both directions; no walk or attack animation.

versions.name: Gravecaller
versions.description: A violet hood with a swept-back peak and a forward brim hides the face but for two green eyes and a glint of jaw; a ragged mantle, a cloak trailing behind with its green lining turned out at the tears, and a bell sleeve reaching to a skull staff crowned with soul fire. Fixes the box skull, the floating pauldrons, the cake-like grimoire and the comb hem with one clean silhouette lit from the upper left, its glow kept at the face and the staff.

versions.name: Bone Tyrant
versions.description: A death lord in lilac-black plate: bone horns off an iron helm over a skull face with green eyes, spiked pauldrons, a ribcage cuirass, a wine cape and tabard over a wide armoured stance, and a staff whose bone prongs cradle a soul orb. Bone appears only as sharp accents on dark armour, so he reads as the master of the skeletons rather than one of them.

versions.name: Grave Warden
versions.description: A plague-doctor gravekeeper: a black wide-brimmed hat and feathered capelet frame a bird-skull mask with a green lens, over a teal coat with bone buttons and a skull charm, and a crook from which hangs a lantern of soul fire. The most distinctive silhouette of the set, with the lantern as its focal glow and no shape shared with any monster.

versions.name: Soulflame
versions.description: A lich whose bare skull burns with green soul fire, three tongues streaming back like the knight’s plume, in midnight-navy robes with a gold-trimmed mantle, a gold-edged front flap and hem, a belt of vertebrae, bone feet and a sickle-headed staff. The fire is the focal point and still reads at 1x, and at night it glows on its own.

versions.name: Blood Lich Reforged
versions.description: The Blood Lich in the game now, with its weirdness fixed: a rounded three-quarter skull under a black iron crown with a soul gem, the cowl draped behind the head, blood-wine robes deeper than the knight’s red, a staff gripped by a visible hand, and an open grimoire whose green fire rises from its gutter. The closest of the five to what ships today.
